title: A Capricorn Schedules Her Fun
topic: Capricorn zodiac satire: a Capricorn schedules her fun
mechanism: Inside a Capricorn there is a mountain with an endless GOALS ladder, a dusty APPROVED stamp at its foot, a FUN dial stuck at 2 and a laptop that never closes; her secret is a folder marked IMPORTANT full of birthday cards.

beats.hook: Glass office under a CAPRICORN badge: Diana's calendar pings 3:15 LAUGH
beats.story: Diana laughs once and gets back to work; her five-year plan has a five-year plan; at 26 she opens a retirement fund; her friends never see her; her vacation was a work trip by a pool
beats.rise: The friends plan a surprise party in a dark meeting room and hide behind the table with a confetti cannon
beats.twist: Diana walks in with her laptop to present; the lights snap on: SURPRISE! The confetti cannon hits her in the face and she tips over backwards with her chair
beats.mechanism: Mountain in her head: a GOALS ladder with no top, an APPROVED stamp covered in dust, a FUN dial stuck at 2, a laptop that never closes, and a folder IMPORTANT full of birthday cards
beats.ending: She stays exactly one hour, books the next party for October and sends everyone a calendar invite

seed.what: The confetti cannon labelled PARTY on the friends' coffee table, with Rina, Tess and Paula
